spans.s:
mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
A teacher.
m. (-ज्यः)
VṚHASPATI, the teacher or Guru of the gods.
f. (-ज्या)
1 A gift, a donation.
2 Sacrificing, making offerings to the gods or manes.
3 Worship, reverence.
4 Meeting, union.
5 A cow.
6 A bawd or procuress.
E.
यज to sacrifice, &c. क्यप् aff.

m. (-लः)
A frequent sacrificer.
E.
इज्या sacrifice, and शील to be frequent, अच् aff.
